Name: RitzyGen's Various Pretty Trees (previously Wisteria Trees)
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
I thought wisteria trees looked really pretty, so I decided to try my hand at making one for stardew valley.(and some other trees) my pixel art skills are very bad, but i tried my best.
I am open to suggestions, also if you want to make a recolor just credit me for the original assets please, that's all :)
List of the trees and the prices Pierre charges for them:
Wisteria Sapling - 2400 g
BubbleTree Sapling - 2200 g
Cherry Blossom Sapling - 2400 g
Year-Round Wisteria Sapling - 2600 g
Dandelion sapling - 2200 g

[size=4]REQUIRES: Content Patcher, SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]Links🔽[/size][size=4]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]

INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS: move the .zip file into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, and extract the files.[/size]

Please do not claim these files as your own mod.
Or post to any other mod sites.
Or post on sites behind a paywall/sell otherwise.
[size=3]!!Do NOT use my mod to train AI, or for any AI-related purposes!![/size]


I plan on adding translation files for this mod, I just need some time to rest first.

Current language(s): English

If there are any bugs please let me know in the "bugs" section of the mod. I will need a SMAPI log to help you. [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log parser[/url]

Downloads.Description: Added Dandelion tree + items, Tweaked (Year-Round) Wisteria Blossoms + items pixel art a bit.
